countries_thin_or_null: Myanmar — limited primary methodology documentation publicly available for recent SNA/COICOP adoption; older SNA 1968/1993 references dominate

dependencies.basis: Philippine System of National Accounts (PSNA) follows the 2008 SNA recommendations; sources and methodology are aligned with the 2008 System of National Accounts Manual.
dependencies.evidence_quote: The sources and methodology of the national accounts is aligned with the 2008 System of National Accounts Manual, which is the latest version of the international statistical standard for the national accounts... The framework is based on the 2008 System of National Accounts (SNA)

dependencies.basis: BSP compiles Balance of Payments statistics in accordance with the IMF Balance of Payments and International Investment Position Manual, 6th Edition (BPM6).
dependencies.evidence_quote: The Philippines' BOP statistics are compiled in accordance with the concepts and standards as set forth in the International Monetary Fund's (IMF) Balance of Payments and International Investment Position Manual, 6th Edition (BPM6) framework

dependencies.basis: Philippine CPI uses the Philippine Classification of Individual Consumption According to Purpose (PCOICOP), which is patterned after the United Nations COICOP.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Philippine Classification of Individual Consumption According to Purpose (PCOICOP) ... The PCOICOP was patterned after the United Nations COICOP.

dependencies.basis: CPI statistical weights at division and item level are derived from expenditure data of the Family Income and Expenditure Survey (FIES).
dependencies.evidence_quote: Statistical weights are applied to the division level down to the Item level of the PCOICOP. The weights are derived from the expenditure data of the FIES.

dependencies.basis: GSO has researched and applied SNA 2008 changes into the handbook on 2008 SNA methodology (published early 2018) and continues alignment from earlier 1993 SNA base.
dependencies.evidence_quote: GSO has researched and applied SNA 2008 changes into the handbook on 2008 SNA methodology which was published in the early 2018.

dependencies.basis: Thailand annual national accounts and quarterly GDP are compiled in line with the 2008 SNA, using chained volume measures.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Both of the annual national accounts and the QGDP are in line with the 2008 SNA, with chained volume measures to express the constant terms.

dependencies.basis: Myanmar national accounts broadly follow the concepts and definitions of the System of National Accounts 1968/1993 (with references to implementation of SNA 1993/2008 elements in surveys).
dependencies.evidence_quote: Myanmar’s NA broadly follows the concepts and definitions of the System of National Accounts 1968.
